glossEn: a distinct feature or element in a problem / a characteristic to be considered
note: a distinct feature or element in a problem / a characteristic to be considered。看待某问题时要考虑的一个要素。线索：an aspect of + 名词。the financial aspect of the plan。

glossEn: the beginning or duration or completion or repetition of the action of a verb
note: the beginning or duration or completion or repetition of the action of a verb。语法学的 aspect（时态/体貌）。线索：verbal aspects / the progressive aspect。
